japanese: 起きて。学校に遅れるわ。
english: Get up. You're gonna be late for school.

japanese: もう起きたよ。
english: I'm up now.

japanese: 寝過ごしちゃった。
english: I've overslept.

japanese: 7時に目覚ましをセットしたんだ。
english: I set the alarm for seven o'clock.

japanese: 目覚ましが鳴ったのが聞こえなかったよ。
english: I couldn't hear my alarm clock going off.

japanese: もう8時？　なんで起こしてくれなかったの？
english: Is it eight already? Why didn't you wake me up?

japanese: よく眠れた？
english: Did you sleep well?

japanese: まだ半分寝てる。
english: I feel only half awake.

japanese: 首を寝違えたな。
english: I woke up with a crick in my neck.

japanese: 新聞を取ってきてくれないか？
english: Can you go and get the newspaper?

japanese: 私の老眼鏡を見なかった？
english: Did you see my reading glasses?

japanese: 朝食にはバタートースト1枚とコーヒーを1杯いただきたいね。
english: I would like a slice of buttered toast and a cup of coffee for breakfast.

japanese: コーヒーができてるはずよ。
english: Coffee should be ready.

japanese: 冷蔵庫からミルクを出してちょうだい。
english: Get the milk from the fridge.

japanese: 腐ってる。
english: It's gone bad.

japanese: ヨーグルトは体にいいのよ。
english: Yogurt is good for you.

japanese: トーストが焦げてる。
english: The toast is burned.

japanese: 食事中は携帯を置きなさい。
english: Put the cell phone down while you're eating.

japanese: あなた、息が臭うわ。
english: You have bad breath.

japanese: 二日酔いは嫌だね。
english: I hate the morning after.

japanese: 着替えなくちゃ。
english: I have to get dressed.

japanese: 何を着るのか決まらない。
english: I can't figure out what to wear.

japanese: ひげを剃る時間がない。
english: I don't have time to shave.

japanese: 忘れ物ない？
english: Got everything?

japanese: 私、どこか変じゃない？
english: Do I look OK?

japanese: 犬に餌をやった？
english: Did you feed the dog?

japanese: お弁当を鞄に入れておくわね。
english: I'll put your lunch in your bag.

japanese: 留守電つけたよ。
english: I've set the answering machine.

japanese: あなた、今日の夕飯は家で食べるの？
english: Will you be eating at home tonight?

japanese: 帰りは遅くならないようにね。
english: Don't be home late.

japanese: 台所のガスをもう一度見て。
english: Double-check the gas in the kitchen.

japanese: パソコンを消そうか？
english: Shall I turn off the computer?

japanese: 電気つけっぱなしだよ。
english: You left the light on.

japanese: 電気ストーブはコンセントを抜いたほうがいいな。
english: I'd better pull out the plug for the electric heater.

japanese: 電気を節約するいい方法なんだ。
english: It's a good way to save electricity.

japanese: 鍵はすべて閉めたかしら？
english: Did I lock up everything?

japanese: ホームセキュリティシステムがセットしてあるか見て。
english: See if the home security system is on.

japanese: もう行くよ。電車に遅れたら嫌だから。
english: I'm going now. I don't want to miss my train.

japanese: 走れば間に合うかも。
english: Maybe I can make it, if I run.

japanese: 定期券を更新しなきゃ。
english: I have to renew my commuter pass.

japanese: 君はどうやって通勤してるの？
english: How do you commute?

japanese: 僕はJRを使ってる。
english: I use the JR line.
note: 下線部「JR line」は「subway（地下鉄）」に置き換え可

japanese: ホームを間違えてる。
english: I'm on the wrong platform.

japanese: 憂鬱な月曜日だ。
english: It's a gloomy Monday.

japanese: 満員電車に乗るのは大嫌い。
english: I hate to travel in a jam-packed train.

japanese: いつも好きな音楽を聞いてやり過ごすの。
english: I always listen to my favorite music and get away with it.

japanese: ラッシュアワーは混雑してる。
english: It's crowded during rush hour.

japanese: あの人たちを見てよ。まったく生気がない。
english: Look at them. They look so lifeless.

japanese: 誰かの強い香水で気持ち悪くなった。
english: Someone's strong perfume made me sick.

japanese: 優先席は健康な若者が占拠してる。
english: The priority seats are occupied by healthy young people.

japanese: 妊婦さんに席を譲ったよ。
english: I gave my seat to a pregnant woman.

japanese: 押さないで。息ができない。
english: Don't push me. I can't breathe.

japanese: 誰かの足を踏んじゃった。
english: I've stepped on someone's foot.

japanese: 乗り過ごした！
english: I've missed my stop!

japanese: 降ります。通してください。
english: I'm getting off. Please let me through.

japanese: おばあさんに道をあけてあげて。
english: Make way for the elderly woman.

japanese: 私に触っていますよ。
english: You're touching me.

japanese: やめないと叫びます。
english: Stop or I'll scream.

japanese: 電車内で痴漢をつかまえた。
english: I caught a train groper on the train.

japanese: 露出狂に遭遇したわ。
english: I ran into a flasher.

japanese: 女の子はお化粧に夢中。
english: A girl is absorbed in putting on makeup.

japanese: 電車が大きく揺れるか、急停車すればいいのに。
english: I hope the train will swing wildly or stop with a jolt.

japanese: 女の人に険しい目でにらまれた。
english: A woman shot me a stern look.

japanese: これは女性専用車両です。
english: This car is for women only.

japanese: おはよう。週末はどうだった？
english: Good morning. How was your weekend?

japanese: あいつ、今朝はやたらご機嫌だな。
english: He is a happy guy this morning.

japanese: 僕のタイムカード押してくれる？
english: Can you punch my time card for me?

japanese: 8時50分に朝礼があります。
english: We have a morning meeting at ten to nine.

japanese: 9時のお客様が既に来ていますよ。
english: Your nine o'clock is already here.

japanese: また遅刻よ。
english: You're late again.

japanese: 事故のせいで電車がひどく遅れてね。
english: The train was terribly delayed because of an accident.

japanese: これ、あなたのコーヒー。ここへ置いておくわね。
english: I got you a coffee. I'll put it right here.

japanese: いつも朝一番でメールをチェックする。
english: I usually check my email first thing in the morning.

japanese: 昨日の夜あなたが帰ってから、コーンウェル氏から電話がありました。
english: Mr. Cornwell called you after you'd left last night.

japanese: 僕に何か郵便物が来てたかな？
english: Did I get any mail?

japanese: この書類を私の机に置いたのは誰？
english: Who left this paper on my desk?

japanese: 3時のABC商事との打ち合わせ、先方の事務所でやるんだけど一緒に来られる？
english: Can you come with me to the meeting with ABC Trading in their office at three?
